text_block_list.text: Super Creek achieved a splendid result despite not being in peak condition. However...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu, haa, haa*...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer... It's okay. Everything's fine, really...So please don't make that face... okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's really... nothing to worry about...
And yet I made you worry anyway...
I'm a terrible big sister... aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!
choice_data_list: Let's get you checked out first!

text_block_list.text:
After having her examined right away,
I had her rest.
And after sleeping for a little while—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, sorry for the trouble~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as long as I rest up, for now at least.
However...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's this strange, heavy feeling
that's been lingering inside my body for a while.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: I looked into it, but—I don't really know what the cause is.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "You don't understand? What do you mean by that...?"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: I've got a slight case of poor circulation, and it looks like it might flare up again...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However, pinpointing the cause is difficult.
And the reason why is—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There's still a lot we don't understand about an Umamusume's body.
There simply aren't enough clinical cases, either.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No way...
choice_data_list: Doctor, is there any way to deal with this?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's make sure not to push it too hard.
Without knowing the cause, we can't know how to treat it either.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Finding that—
Trainer, that's your job."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, through daily observation, we must identify
the causes of any issues and eliminate them.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"And for the time being,
be sure to give careful consideration to her race schedule."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by "a while"...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Right, as a rough guideline...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Half a year.
Until autumn arrives.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Autumn... No way...
Then what about the Classics...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go as far as calling it hopeless. But common
sense-wise, it would be wiser to pass on it.
That day, I let Super Creek sleep in the infirmary and decided to head home.

As I was about to leave, I suddenly sensed a presence in the courtyard.
When I looked over...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... It was a once-in-a-lifetime chance...
The Satsuki Sho and the Derby
that I wanted to give to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Three... I promised I'd give you three no matter what.
Ugh, uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahn!

Super Creek wept like a child.
It was so heartbreaking, I couldn't even find the words to speak...

For now, we set our next goal as the Kikuka Sho.
Will we be able to... uncover the cause?
